cards.meaning: to soar, shoot up sharply (of prices or inflation)
cards.example: Sumirit ang inaasahang implasyon ngayong Setyembre, ayon sa BSP.
cards.exampleMeaning: Inflation is expected to soar this September, according to the BSP.
cards.note: Pang-balita at madrama ang dating; mas matindi kaysa 'tumaas.' Mababasa sa mga headline, hindi sa pormal na ulat ng BSP.

cards.meaning: temporary, for the time being (with an expected resumption or replacement)
cards.example: Pansamantalang itinigil ang pagdinig bago ang mga sesyon simula Oktubre 1.
cards.exampleMeaning: The hearing was temporarily halted ahead of the sessions starting October 1.
cards.note: Neutral at pormal. Iba sa 'panandalian' (sandali lamang); ang pansamantala ay may inaasahang kapalit o pagbabalik.
cards.tiesTo: Impeachment court's procedural pause before the Oct 1-15 marathon sessions

cards.example: 政府给首次购房者提供房贷利息补贴。
cards.examplePinyin: Zhèngfǔ gěi shǒucì gòufáng zhě tígōng fángdài lìxī bǔtiē.
cards.exampleMeaning: The government provides a mortgage interest subsidy to first-time home buyers.
cards.note: 书面语/policy register. Near-synonym 补助 (bǔzhù) is welfare-style aid to individuals; 补贴 covers a cost gap as a policy tool. Collocation: 房贷利息补贴, 财政补贴.
cards.tiesTo: Beijing's 1-point mortgage interest subsidy for first-home buyers

cards.example: 连专业人士都看不懂，何况普通老百姓呢？
cards.examplePinyin: Lián zhuānyè rénshì dōu kàn bù dǒng, hékuàng pǔtōng lǎobǎixìng ne?
cards.exampleMeaning: Even professionals can't make sense of it, let alone ordinary people.
cards.note: Advanced connective, both spoken and written. Pattern 连…都…，何况…. Near-synonym 甚至 just adds emphasis; 何况 carries the logic that the bigger case follows automatically.
cards.tiesTo: China's property package: even experts see limited scale, let alone the market
